image_enrichment.source_policy: Cricbuzz canonical profile portrait when available; Wikipedia/Wikimedia exact-player page fallback; external existing URL retained only when no canonical source was found.
image_enrichment.final_policy: Player-specific Cricbuzz/Cricinfo portrait first; exact Wikipedia portrait for selected historical players; original dataset image asset recovered only when no public profile portrait was found automatically.
image_enrichment.verification_note: image_verified=true means the URL is tied to a named Cricbuzz/Cricinfo/Wikipedia/Wikimedia source; image_verified=false means the URL was retained or recovered from the original dataset asset without independent source-page matching.
